name: ReactionDiffusionBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a reaction-diffusion coral structure. The object displays a rounded dome shape with a surface patterned by deeply pitted cells and raised ridges generated through a reaction-diffusion algorithm, creating an irregular, organic cellular texture across the entire dome. Without any texture or material color, the white mesh reveals the complex network of small concave cells and interconnecting ridges at varying scales, with a dark shadow at the base contrasting with the white geometry above.
